dashboard_recap.headline: MLB Daily Recap - July 04, 2026
dashboard_recap.article:
**Pirates Outlast Nationals 7-1, Twins Crush Yankees 11-4**

The Pittsburgh Pirates continued their winning ways, defeating the Washington Nationals 7-1 behind Braxton Ashcraft's dominating performance. Ashcraft tossed 5.2 innings, allowing just one earned run while striking out seven. Bryan Reynolds and Ryan O'Hearn led the Pirates' offense with two hits apiece. In other action, the Minnesota Twins exploded for 11 runs, with Josh Bell hitting two home runs and driving in three to lead the way. Bell's second homer of the game came off Brendan Beck, who took the loss.

**Rays Fall to Astros in Thriller, Blue Jays Shut Out by Mariners**

In a back-and-forth contest, the Houston Astros outlasted the Tampa Bay Rays 10-8. Yordan Alvarez hit two home runs, including a go-ahead shot in the eighth, to pace the Astros' offense. The Seattle Mariners meanwhile, pummeled the Toronto Blue Jays 11-0 behind Logan Gilbert's seven shutout innings. Randy Arozarena hit a home run and drove in four for the Mariners.

**Cardinals Blank Cubs 3-0, White Sox Edge Guardians 3-1**

The St. Louis Cardinals earned a shutout victory over the Chicago Cubs, with Kyle Leahy tossing five scoreless innings. JJ Wetherholt hit a home run for the Cardinals. Meanwhile, the Chicago White Sox edged the Cleveland Guardians 3-1 behind Sean Burke's six strong innings and 11 strikeouts. Colson Montgomery hit a home run for the White Sox.

**Astros, Giants, Phillies, Red Sox, Marlins, and Dodgers Win**

The Houston Astros (10-8), San Francisco Giants (6-4), Philadelphia Phillies (6-1), Boston Red Sox (8-1), Miami Marlins (7-2), and Los Angeles Dodgers (3-0) all earned victories in their respective games.
